references.text: The same introductory formula, "The Lord spoke to Moses and said," is used consistently in the Books of Moses to introduce divine commands.
The Lord speaks to Moses on Mount Sinai, using the same formula for divine revelation.
The opening formula in Leviticus where the Lord calls to Moses and speaks to him.
The same standard formula for divine speech to Moses in Leviticus.
Earlier in the same chapter, the same introductory formula is used for the Lord's speech to Moses.
Numbers opens with the same formula where the Lord speaks to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai.
Repetition of the formula "The Lord spoke to Moses and said" as an introduction to new laws.
